title: ADJUST THROTTLE POSITION SENSOR / REPLACEMENT OF THROTTLE POSITION SENSOR

content.description: Hands loosening two screws on the throttle position sensor mounted on the throttle body
Ohmmeter connected to throttle position sensor terminals IDL and E2 on the throttle body

items: (b) Connect the ohmmeter to the throttle position sensor terminals IDL and E2.
(c) Insert a thickness gauge (0.50 mm or 0.0197 in.) between the throttle stop screw and lever. Gradually turn the sensor clockwise until the ohmmeter deflects, and secure the sensor with two screws.

content.description: Thickness gauge being inserted between throttle stop screw and lever on throttle body

items: (d) Using a thickness gauge, recheck the continuity between terminals IDL and E2.

headers: Clearance between lever and stop screw

content.text: Remove two screws and the sensor from the throttle body.

content.description: Hands removing throttle position sensor from throttle body by removing two screws
Hand installing throttle position sensor onto throttle body

items: (a) Check that the throttle valve is fully closed.
(b) Place the sensor on the throttle body as shown in the figure.
(c) Turn the sensor clockwise, and temporarily install the two screws.
